env_setup.container.A2.content.en:
Select the A2 image and start the docker container on each node, refer to [using docker](../../installation.md#set-up-using-docker).

This scenario uses **2 NPUs per node**; expose `davinci0`/`davinci1` (adjust if your cards use different indexes):

```bash
export IMAGE=quay.io/ascend/vllm-ascend:v0.23.0rc1
docker run --rm \
    --name vllm-ascend \
    --shm-size=64g \
    --net=host \
    --device /dev/davinci0 \
    --device /dev/davinci1 \
    --device /dev/davinci_manager \
    --device /dev/devmm_svm \
    --device /dev/hisi_hdc \
    -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \
    -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver/tools/hccn_tool:/usr/local/Ascend/driver/tools/hccn_tool \
    -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \
    -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver/lib64/:/usr/local/Ascend/driver/lib64/ \
    -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info:/usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info \
    -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
    -v /etc/hccn.conf:/etc/hccn.conf \
    -it $IMAGE bash
```
env_setup.container.A2.content.zh:
选择 A2 镜像并在每个节点启动容器,参考[使用 Docker](../../installation.md#set-up-using-docker)。

本场景每个节点使用 **2 张 NPU**;暴露 `davinci0`/`davinci1`(若您的卡索引不同请调整):

```bash
export IMAGE=quay.io/ascend/vllm-ascend:v0.23.0rc1
docker run --rm \
    --name vllm-ascend \
    --shm-size=64g \
    --net=host \
    --device /dev/davinci0 \
    --device /dev/davinci1 \
    --device /dev/davinci_manager \
    --device /dev/devmm_svm \
    --device /dev/hisi_hdc \
    -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \
    -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver/tools/hccn_tool:/usr/local/Ascend/driver/tools/hccn_tool \
    -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \
    -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver/lib64/:/usr/local/Ascend/driver/lib64/ \
    -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info:/usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info \
    -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
    -v /etc/hccn.conf:/etc/hccn.conf \
    -it $IMAGE bash
```

scenarios[0].case.zh: 1P1D(1 个 Prefill 节点 + 1 个 Decode 节点)

scenarios[0].steps[0].content.en:
Use **2 Atlas 800 A2 nodes** — one Prefill node, one Decode node. Each node runs
`TP=1 + DP=2`, using 2 NPUs. This is the lightest PD topology: 1P1D, 2 cards per node,
driven by `launch_online_dp.py` external DP (Mooncake KV transfer).
scenarios[0].steps[0].content.zh:
使用 **2 台 Atlas 800 A2 节点**——1 个 Prefill 节点、1 个 Decode 节点。每个节点运行
`TP=1 + DP=2`,使用 2 张 NPU。这是最轻量的 PD 拓扑:1P1D、每节点 2 卡,
由 `launch_online_dp.py` 外部 DP 驱动(Mooncake KV 传输)。

scenarios[0].steps[1].title.zh: 准备 run_dp_template.sh – Prefill 节点

scenarios[0].steps[1].content.en:
Prefill node:

```shell
# HCCL auto-discovers the HCCN interfaces. Do NOT force
# HCCL_IF_IP / socket ifnames onto the management NIC — that fails with
# HCCL "ERR02005 DIST internal error" in the vllm engine.
export PYTORCH_NPU_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True
export OMP_PROC_BIND=false
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=10
export TASK_QUEUE_ENABLE=1
export HCCL_BUFFSIZE=256
# launch_online_dp.py passes logical device indexes; map them onto the
# container's assigned physical devices (ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES).
IFS=',' read -r -a selected_devices <<< "${ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES:-0,1}"
export ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES="${selected_devices[$1]}"
export VLLM_ASCEND_ENABLE_FLASHCOMM1=0

vllm serve your_model_path \
    --host 0.0.0.0 \
    --port $2 \
    --served-model-name dsv2 \
    --data-parallel-size $3 \
    --data-parallel-rank $4 \
    --data-parallel-address $5 \
    --data-parallel-rpc-port $6 \
    --tensor-parallel-size $7 \
    --trust-remote-code \
    --enable-expert-parallel \
    --quantization ascend \
    --max-model-len {{max_model_len}} \
    --max-num-seqs {{max_num_seqs}} \
    --kv-transfer-config '{"kv_connector": "MooncakeConnectorV1", "kv_role": "kv_producer", "kv_port": "30000", "engine_id": "0", "kv_connector_extra_config": {"prefill": {"dp_size": 2, "tp_size": 1}, "decode": {"dp_size": 2, "tp_size": 1}}}'
```

```shell
export ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES="${selected_devices[$1]}"
export VLLM_ASCEND_ENABLE_FLASHCOMM1=0

vllm serve your_model_path \
    --host 0.0.0.0 \
    --port $2 \
    --served-model-name dsv2 \
    --data-parallel-size $3 \
    --data-parallel-rank $4 \
    --data-parallel-address $5 \
    --data-parallel-rpc-port $6 \
    --tensor-parallel-size $7 \
    --trust-remote-code \
    --enable-expert-parallel \
    --quantization ascend \
    --max-model-len {{max_model_len}} \
    --max-num-seqs {{max_num_seqs}} \
    --kv-transfer-config '{"kv_connector": "MooncakeConnectorV1", "kv_role": "kv_producer", "kv_port": "30000", "engine_id": "0", "kv_connector_extra_config": {"prefill": {"dp_size": 2, "tp_size": 1}, "decode": {"dp_size": 2, "tp_size": 1}}}'
```


scenarios[0].steps[4].content.en:
```bash
# Query the prefill node's OpenAI-compatible endpoint (or the proxy if deployed)
curl -s http://<node0_ip>:7100/v1/models
# Send a chat completion to confirm prefill/decode are cooperating
curl -s http://<node0_ip>:7100/v1/chat/completions \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model": "dsv2", "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "hello"}], "max_tokens": 16}'
```
